item.title: Solberg leads Evans in Toyota one-two
item.description: Oliver Solberg led Toyota Gazoo Racing World Rally Team teammate Elfyn Evans after a muddy and slippery opening day at Rally Chile on Friday. Solberg and co-driver Elliott Edmondson completed the six stages in 52 minutes and 42.1 seconds. They held a 10.1-second advantage over Evans and Scott Martin
